slides.title: Connect and define a model
slides.html:
Mongoose

Connect and define a model

  • Connect once: mongoose.connect(MONGO_URI)
  • Schema: the shape and rules of a document
  • Model: what you use to query a collection
  • Mongoose adds _id and timestamps

models/Job.js

const jobSchema = new mongoose.Schema(
  {
    title: { type: String, required: true, trim: true },
    company: { type: String, required: true },
    location: { type: String, default: "Remote" },
    owner: { type: mongoose.Schema.Types.ObjectId, ref: "User" },
  },
  { timestamps: true }
);
 
export default mongoose.model("Job", jobSchema);

CRUD

CRUD with Mongoose

slides.title: Never store plain passwords
slides.html:
Passwords

Never store plain passwords

  • bcrypt turns a password into a hash
  • A hash can't be turned back
  • To log in, compare the attempt with the hash

bcrypt

import bcrypt from "bcryptjs";
 
const hash = await bcrypt.hash("secret123", 10);
// $2a$10$Xk9... (safe to store)
 
const ok = await bcrypt.compare("secret123", hash);
// true

slides.title: Login with a JSON Web Token
slides.html:
JWT

Login with a JSON Web Token

  • Check the email exists and the password matches
  • Sign a token with the user id
  • The client sends it back on every request

controllers/auth.js

import jwt from "jsonwebtoken";
 
export const login = async (req, res) => {
  const { email, password } = req.body;
  const user = await User.findOne({ email });
  if (!user || !(await bcrypt.compare(password, user.password)))
    return res.status(401).json({ message: "Wrong email or password" });
 
  const token = jwt.sign({ id: user._id }, process.env.JWT_SECRET,
    { expiresIn: "7d" });
  res.json({ token, user: { id: user._id, name: user.name } });
};

slides.title: Protecting routes
slides.html:
Protect

Protecting routes

  • Middleware reads Authorization: Bearer <token>
  • Verifies it and sets req.user
  • Check ownership before edits

middleware/auth.js

export const protect = (req, res, next) => {
  const token = req.headers.authorization?.split(" ")[1];
  if (!token) return res.status(401).json({ message: "Please log in" });
  try {
    req.user = jwt.verify(token, process.env.JWT_SECRET);
    next();
  } catch {
    res.status(401).json({ message: "Session expired" });
  }
};
 
router.post("/", protect, jobs.create);

slides.title: Only the owner can delete
slides.html:
Build

Only the owner can delete

  • Find the job
  • 403 if it belongs to someone else
  • Compare ids as strings

controllers/jobs.js

export const remove = async (req, res) => {
  const job = await Job.findById(req.params.id);
  if (!job) return res.status(404).json({ message: "Job not found" });
 
  if (job.owner.toString() !== req.user.id)
    return res.status(403).json({ message: "Not your job post" });
 
  await job.deleteOne();
  res.status(204).end();
};
